reviewer_provenance.relationship: Implementing assistant; not independent human review
reviewer_provenance.blinding: Unblinded: aggregate gate counts and answers had been inspected before annotation.
reviewer_provenance.method: Reviewed all 60 question/record/answer pairs and retrieved evidence; labels are provisional judgments separate from gate decisions.
reviewer_provenance.caveats: Supported evaluates assertions against synthetic evidence, not real financial advice. Completeness of indirect complaints is subjective. Three refusals about absent decline reasons count as complete evidence-limited answers; requests for an already supplied reference remain a usability flaw.

note: One AI/author review is provisional; scripted outputs, paired cases are not independent.
